subject: Fix VLA stack overflow in TLS writev after write failure (#4307)
reason: The only behavioral change is the fix to the VLA stack overflow in src/tls.c connTLSWritev, reachable solely on a TLS client connection after a forced TLS write failure followed by a large scatter/gather reply (connTLSWritev is the TLS connection type's writev; plain/unix connections use the untouched connSocketWritev). The fuzzer has no TLS transport: every client it opens is plain TCP (valkey.Valkey, the key-value workload, command actions) or a unix socket (valkey.action.commands and private servers), none of which enter connTLSWritev; there is no TLS-capable component and no certificate pr
